recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add MedicationDispense as an EOB prescription target for this issue; future item-level dispense linkage should be handled under newer EOB/Claim modeling work if the work group decides it is needed.
issue_request: FHIR-11818 was a Published FHIR-core ExplanationOfBenefit change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that MedicationDispense be included in ExplanationOfBenefit in addition to MedicationOrder because an EOB can reflect what was issued to the patient. The resolution said MedicationDispense can now be provided in x.information.value[x].
initial_application: No current git history commit found by this reconciliation explicitly mentions FHIR-11818. Current source maps the historical ExplanationOfBenefit.information element to ExplanationOfBenefit.supportingInfo, and historical R4B source already allowed supportingInfo.value[x] as Reference(Resource); the current source has since broadened the element to wildcard value[x] while retaining definition/comment text for resources and references.
additional_context: ExplanationOfBenefit is active in source/fhir.ini. Later closely related pharmacy/EOB decisions do not require a prescription-target change: FHIR-17772 was Resolved - No Change and pointed to FHIR-17735; FHIR-17735 handled dispensed-drug placement for Claim via productOrService/drug code; and FHIR-22775 was Resolved - No Change with the clarification that EOB prescription uses RX information rather than dispensed information. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative current EOB StructureDefinition already permits supportingInfo.value[x] to carry the requested supporting data, and adding MedicationDispense to EOB.prescription/originalPrescription would be overbroad and contrary to later no-change decisions.

related_jiras.note: Claim pharmacy dispense placement was handled through productOrService/drug code rather than a dispense reference.
Later EOB request to include a MedicationDispense reference was Resolved - No Change and pointed to FHIR-17735.
Later EOB.prescription-to-MedicationDispense request was Resolved - No Change because claims use RX information, not dispensed information.
